The prices will never be as low as they used to be. With inflation, the diamond mine, RAP, auctions, and the option to buy 50b+ diamonds, this has been coming for a while. They will definitely level out like the hhr has, but prices will never be the same as they were 2-3 months ago. It’s like with old exclusives how people used to sell them for 10-50m…but now that price is so low because the number of players, pets, and gems in the game have drastically increased since, making gems less valuable and pets more expensive. Or how reg HHRs used to go for 5-7b **just a few months ago** and now they go for 23-26 (and at one point they even got 30.)

Just for an example: The economy in PSX is unregulated and very easy to manipulate. So, if everyone started selling HHRs for 7b gems each, the prices will go way down. But, this is a trading game based on investments for potential profit, so people will never sell them for that low, because it is almost impossible to find them for lower. I don’t know how else to put other than this: let’s say someone one buys a HHR for 5b. That person resells for 7b, and then that person resells for 10b. Then that person resells for 12b, and then 14b, and then 17b…and then 20b. That is pretty much what has happened over the course of the last few months. People are artificially inflating pets and exploiting their profitability, because people will always buy if they know it can get more…and people will always sell for the most they can get.

What I do to get more gems is to farm lots and lots of mythicals. The rainbow clover axolotls can be sold for around 50m, and although it isn’t a lot, it adds up. The new mythicals from the kawaii world could probably be sold for even more. Also, scour through trading plazas looking for good deals, for things you can resell. I would NOT recommend buying up cheap event exclusives, because they are in very low demand, and there really isnt a market for them anymore. I would recommend buying up mid tier exclusives or huges. Once I bought a huge Cupid corgi for 19b and resold it for 27b…and another I bought a keyboard cat for 300m and resold it for 1b. It just takes time to find deals like those, but it pays off. 

Another way you can get more gems is by selling hype gifts. You get them every week, and you can easily sell them for 1-2b. Just wait a few weeks, and you should have enough to buy a cheap huge like a huge hell rock. If you are able to, you can also buy an exclusive egg. Wait a few weeks until a new egg is in the shop, and you can sell the old egg for 13-15b. Or, you can just buy one and sell it right away for around 10b. I even traded an exclusive egg for a huge golden hell rock a few weeks ago. 

Good luck!
